messages:
mike.thompson: PagerDuty fired for `redwood-inference-prod` but pages are going to the SRE rotation not the product-oncall. anyone else seeing this?

pagerduty-bot: [alert] PagerDuty: redwood-inference-prod - High error rate on inference API. Incident: PD-6421. Triggered at 2025-10-12 09:07:14 UTC. Escalation policy: SRE-Team.

sara.li: whoa that’s wrong — product team should get the page for 10x error spikes. did we change the policy?

alex.rivera: I pushed a schedule refactor last night for PD services. I only updated the prod-frontend policy, thought this one was checked. opening PD console now.

rami.patel: Received SMS, not me on call. I acked to stop noise but i'm not the right responder. Marking as temporary ack.

mike.thompson: please DO NOT post more status updates in PD; coordinate here. If the wrong people are acking, we could lose proper mitigation.

alex.rivera: looked at the service config — `redwood-inference-prod` is pointing to escalation policy `SRE-Team` due to a mis-typed variable in our deploy script (`${PD_POLICY:-SRE-Team}`) which defaulted because PROD_PD_POLICY env var was empty. snippet: ```bash
# bad: default to SRE-Team when unset
PD_POLICY=${PROD_PD_POLICY:-SRE-Team}
# should be explicit or fail
```

sara.li: that explains it. any immediate customer impact? metrics show a spike in 5xx and latency across hosted API. Some customers seeing errors.

mike.thompson: Customer impact: partial — 10% of requests 500s over last 8 minutes, p95 latency doubled. Graceful degradation not kicking in because wrong route removed fallback triggers. tagging billing/ops?

rami.patel: adding temporary oncall: @oncall-temp stepping in to field customer comms and triage. can we re-route PD to product-oncall now?

incident-bot: paging action requested by mike.thompson. Reassigning service redwood-inference-prod to escalation policy Product-Oncall (temp) and dispatching.

pagerduty-bot: [update] Escalation policy updated for redwood-inference-prod by alex.rivera. New policy: Product-Oncall. Next step: notify current oncall via SMS and push.

oncall-temp: I’m online, I’ve started a thread with legal/sales for customers on active contracts. Also running quick checks on model-serving nodes.

sara.li: mitigation plan: 1) revert the deploy script default, 2) create PD smoke test that validates policy per service after deploy, 3) run targeted traffic to verify fallback. who owns 1-2?

alex.rivera: I’ll own 1 and 2 — will open an RFC and a follow-up PR to change default behavior to fail CI if PROD_PD_POLICY is unset.

mike.thompson: who’s doing live rollback of infra change that caused the 5xx? we might need to scale autoscalers or rollback the feature flag.

rami.patel: ops scaled the inference pools and disabled a recent batching optimization flagged in telemetry. rolling back that opt reduces 5xx immediately.

pagerduty-bot: [info] Incident PD-6421 acknowledged by rami.patel at 2025-10-12 09:12:02 UTC.

mike.thompson: confirming: service is rerouted, product-oncall has notifications, autoscale adjusted, batching opt rolled back. any outstanding pager issues?

sara.li: PD escalation policy check: we should also verify global escalation rules (time-to-escalate) because wrong policy may have longer delays.

alex.rivera: verified escalation times — matched expected. The main problem was the wrong policy target. Adding unit test and a PD sanity check in deploy pipeline.

oncall-temp: customer impact update: most customers recovered after rollback; 3 accounts had degraded throughput ~5-10 minutes. sent initial comms and offering post-mortem.

incident-bot: autopage suppression active while mitigation in progress.

mike.thompson: action items: 1) alex: PR to remove default policy and add PD smoke test (due EOD), 2) infra: add canary alert to detect routing mismatches, 3) ops: run PD routing audit for last 30 days, 4) oncall: document manual re-route steps.

alex.rivera: PR opened: https://git.redwood/infra/pd-policy-fix - includes CI test that checks service→policy mapping.

rami.patel: ops audit: starting now — will post findings.

sara.li: handoff: I’ll be on-call for follow-ups for the next 2 hours then hand to mike. any objections?

mike.thompson: fine. please also file a postmortem and label PD-routing-misconfig in tags.

oncall-temp: closing notes: customer comms sent, support tickets created for the 3 impacted accounts, and temporary PD override removed. Monitoring looks green for last 18 minutes.

pagerduty-bot: [resolve] Incident PD-6421 resolved at 2025-10-12 09:58:01 UTC.

mike.thompson: good job triaging quickly. Postmortem owners: alex (root cause & code fix), rami (ops audit), sara (customer comms). please add timelines and follow-ups in the postmortem doc.

sara.li: noted — starting postmortem doc now.

mike.thompson: ok team — we’ll sync on the outage review tomorrow 10:30am PT. closing thread. :thumbsup:
